description: The schema-based file structure every AmberX AXF app is initialized with. `axf validate` enforces the required entries.

entries.purpose: Project manifest (project-manifest@1): name (= hub folder /projects/<name>), repo, relation to AXF, shared data. Nothing is loaded or compiled without a valid one.
App identity, framework version and the default asset for every slot.
Hashes of the baked framework files, used for conformance checks.
Baked framework runtime: engines, React layer and base CSS. Managed by the build engine.
Hot-swappable assets, one folder per asset type.
App views registered with the shell.
Handlers bound to the standard action vocabulary.
App-specific dialogs opened through the dialog engine.
